name: PayNow sales
author: Brick_Bread
description: Celebrates every sale on your PayNow store with an alert in the pill and a glow animation.

settings.label: Store ID
settings.description: In the PayNow dashboard under Settings > General.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Create one in the PayNow dashboard under Settings > API Keys; it only needs to read orders. Stored encrypted for your Windows account.

settings.label: Animation
settings.description: Played on the glow around the pill for each sale.

settings.label: Big sale from (store currency)
settings.description: Sales of at least this much get a longer, wider animation. 0 treats every sale the same.

settings.label: Keep a reminder in the pill until I look
settings.description: After the alert, the pill keeps showing how many sales came in until you open the PayNow tab or the Plugins tab.

settings.label: Ignore free orders
settings.description: Orders that total nothing, such as fully discounted ones, are counted but not announced.
